content.value_statement: Blockchain integrations often fail because RPC errors, gas estimates, nonces, and chain settings behave differently. This skill provides review checklists and safer coding patterns for smart contract calls.
actual_capabilities: Checks contract call handling for try/catch, address validation, revert handling, and multicall failure isolation.
Shows gas estimation patterns with a buffer, EIP-1559 fees, simulation, and gas-price limits.
Defines chain-specific RPC, block time, confirmation, and native token configuration examples.
Explains nonce tracking for concurrent transactions using pending transaction counts.
Provides retry and fallback RPC endpoint patterns for rate-limited providers.
limitations: Does not execute transactions or connect to live RPC providers.
Does not audit smart contract bytecode or prove protocol correctness.
Example endpoints and environment variable names must be replaced before production use.
Advice is general and still requires chain-specific testing.

use_cases.title: Review dApp Transaction Code
use_cases.description: Check swap, quote, and contract call flows for missing error handling, simulation, and gas safeguards.

use_cases.title: Harden Multi-Chain Configuration
use_cases.description: Compare chain IDs, RPC URLs, block times, confirmations, and native tokens before deployment.

use_cases.title: Audit Operational Runbooks
use_cases.description: Validate retry behavior, nonce management, and fallback RPC planning for production transaction systems.

prompt_templates.title: Check Basic RPC Handling
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a contract call workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my blockchain RPC call flow for missing try/catch blocks, invalid address handling, and revert handling.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Gas Safety
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this transaction plan for gas estimation, gas buffers, EIP-1559 fee handling, and pre-send simulation.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Multi-Chain Settings
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my multi-chain configuration for chain-specific confirmations, block times, RPC URLs, and native token assumptions.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Production Transaction Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced reliability review for a live transaction system.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my production transaction workflow for nonce conflicts, retry behavior, fallback RPC strategy, multicall safety, and failure isolation.

output_examples.input: Review my token quote workflow for low-liquidity pairs.
output: Wrap each quote call in isolated error handling so one failed pool does not stop the full batch.
Return a neutral result for expected reverts such as missing pools or insufficient liquidity.
Use per-call failure handling when batching quotes through multicall.

output_examples.input: Plan transaction submission for a swap router on Ethereum and Polygon.
output: Estimate gas before submission and add a clear buffer.
Simulate the swap before signing to catch reverts early.
Use different confirmation targets and block-time assumptions for each chain.

output_examples.input: Review retry behavior for a rate-limited RPC provider.
output: Retry only expected rate-limit failures with exponential backoff.
Preserve hard failures so they are visible to operators.
Use fallback RPC providers and monitor when traffic shifts between them.

best_practices: Simulate every transaction before signing or broadcasting it.
Use per-chain configuration for confirmations, block times, and native tokens.
Treat RPC failures, reverts, and rate limits as expected control flow.
anti_patterns: Sending transactions without gas estimation and an explicit buffer.
Using multicall without per-call failure handling.
Sharing one nonce source across concurrent senders without coordination.

faq.question: Does this skill execute blockchain transactions?
faq.answer: No. It provides review guidance and examples for safer transaction handling.

faq.question: Can it replace a smart contract audit?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on application integration patterns, not contract bytecode or protocol logic.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it support multiple chains?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for chain-specific configuration and confirmation settings.

faq.question: Does it include gas guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers estimation, buffers, EIP-1559 fee fields, and simulation before execution.

faq.question: Does it require secrets or wallet access?
faq.answer: No. The examples reference RPC URL variables only and do not request wallet credentials.
